answer: Proof of useful work provides robust Sybil resistance by anchoring agent identity to computational scarcity. An attacker must commit significant energy to solve puzzles at each graph vertex, rendering the creation of infinite identities economically non-viable. Like a digital relic of past energy expenditure, this proof confirms participation, ensuring that the cost of entry remains high regardless of jade-tinted aspirations for effortless scale. This mechanism forces adversaries to incur hardware and utility costs that scale linearly with the number of sybils deployed.
